title: 16 January 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the final date of Another Beatles Christmas Show, which had begun on 24 December 1964 at London’s Hammersmith Odeon.

There were two shows on this night, with guest performers including Freddie And The Dreamers, Sounds Incorporated, Elkie Brooks, The Yardbirds, Michael Haslam, The Mike Cotton Sound and Ray Fell. The compère was Jimmy Savile.

The Beatles appeared in two sketches, one with Freddie Garrity of Freddie And The Dreamers, and another with Jimmy Savile. They closed the shows with an 11-song set: ‘Twist And Shout’, ‘I’m A Loser’, ‘Baby’s In Black’, ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, ‘Honey Don’t’, ‘I Feel Fine’, ‘She’s A Woman’, ‘A Hard Day’s Night’, ‘Rock And Roll Music’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 13 October 2021

Also on this day...

  • 2021: Phil Spector dies
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Wembley Arena, London
  • 1981: UK single release: Woman by John Lennon
  • 1980: Paul McCartney is arrested in Japan for marijuana possession
  • 1979: Recording, mixing: Daytime Nighttime Suffering by Wings
  • 1978: Mixing: Famous Groupies, Morse Moose And The Grey Goose by Wings
  • 1976: Recording: Silly Love Songs by Wings
  • 1975: Travel: Paul McCartney – New York to New Orleans
  • 1973: Editing: Hold Me Tight/Lazy Dynamite/Hands Of Love/Power Cut by Wings
  • 1970: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition is raided by police
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 10
  • 1967: Joe Orton begins writing a script for The Beatles’ third film
  • 1964: The Beatles reach number one in America
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
  • 1963: Radio: Here We Go
  • 1963: Television: People And Places
  • 1957: The Cavern Club opens in Mathew Street, Liverpool
